units.source_text: 此时，左右为难的大臣难以分辨孰是孰非，

en.t: At this point, the minister, caught in a dilemma, could not tell who was right and who was wrong,

units.source_text: 他看了看发长彦，又看了看两位武士，

en.t: he looked at Hatsunagahiko, then looked at the two warriors,

units.source_text: 于是转头问自己的两位女儿：“如今能解决这件事的就剩下你们了。

en.t: so he turned and asked his two daughters, "Now only you can settle this matter.
Who was it, really, who saved you?"
